title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Abongan, Municipality of Taytay, Province of Palawan, to Be Known as the Abongan High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Abongan, Municipality of Taytay, Province of Palawan, to Be Known as the Abongan High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Abongan, Thị trấn Taytay, Tỉnh Palawan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Abongan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Abongan, เทศบาล Taytay, จังหวัด Palawan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Abongan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Abongan, Kotamadya Taytay, Provinsi Palawan dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Abongan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Abongan, Perbandaran Taytay, Wilayah Palawan dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Abongan

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Abongan, Municipality of Taytay, Province of Palawan, to be known as the Abongan High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
